card.name: All-caps warning headings and titles
card.fires_on: Words inside all-caps headings, such as boxed warning titles or article headings, often small linking words or partway through a long word. It fires where the next piece is expected to be capitalized.

modes.label: Linking words in caps
modes.description: Small words like TO, BE or AND inside an all-caps warning sentence or heading.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL IDEATION IN CHILDREN<< AND>> ADOLESCENTS See full prescribing

modes.label: Inside long caps words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long medical word written in capitals.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS MENING<<OC>>OCCAL INFECTIONS See full

modes.label: Heading break
modes.description: A separator mark before an all-caps article title.

card.writes: It seems to push the next piece toward capitalized word starts such as CO, MO and CA.
card.plain: It marks capital-letter headings and long capitalized words where more capitals come next.
